text: Allah gave Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, a kingdom no one will ever have again. And the word he kept saying was: thanks.
Remember Qarun? He was given treasure and said: "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." The earth swallowed him.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, was given far more, and said: "This is from the favour of my Lord."
So today, look at one thing Allah gave you: your health, your family, your home, and say his dua: "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour."
Which part of the story of Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, amazed you most: the ant, the hoopoe, or the throne? Tell us in the comments.
Next week: Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, thrown into a fire so large no one could come near it... and why it did not burn him.
